summary: Legend Biotech Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on June 17, 2026 for an underwritten public offering of $225 million in American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing two ordinary shares. The ADSs are listed on Nasdaq under LEGN; the last reported sale price on June 16, 2026 was $33.38 per ADS. Joint bookrunners are Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, Citigroup, and Deutsche Bank Securities. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The filing includes standard risk factors, use of proceeds, and underwriting arrangements with a T+2 settlement cycle. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns are present.
